title: Tetraptycene derivatives: synthesis, structure and their self-assemblies in solid state
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8293-8299
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00376H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bin-Bin Yang, Si-Yuan Wu, Qing-Pu Zhang, Hui Ma, Yu-Ling Sun, Chun Zhang
A series of hydroxyl- or methoxy-substituted tetraptycene derivatives from the photochemical reactions of anthracene derivatives was obtained and characterized. Their self-assemblies in the solid state were further discussed.
